note: Letter no. 92 (P. van Brederode to Oldenbarnevelt, 21 Feb 1605, printed in cipher) runs pp.110-111 (page_index 124-125, source=2). pp.108-109 and p.112 fetched as surrounding context (end of no.91, start of no.93 -- neither carries cipher). voorwerk_XIII.jpg is the editor's preface page where he states this is the only ciphered item in the volume and he could not find the key.

pages.content: end of no. 91 (De raadsheren in het Hof van Holland aan Oldenbarnevelt, 21 dec 1604); no cipher
end of no. 91's citation; no. 92 [P. van Brederode aan Oldenbarnevelt], 21 feb 1605, begins -- cipher present
no. 92 continues and ends, citation 'A.R.A., Holland 2613, e. Duplicata.'; no. 93 (Louise Juliana) begins -- cipher present
end of no. 93 (French, Louise Juliana); no. 94 begins; no cipher

editor's preface: 'Cijferschrift kwam in dit deel maar in een stuk voor, nr. 92; ik zou het hebben opgelost, als ik gekund had. Maar de sleutel erop heb ik niet kunnen vinden, en de brief bood te weinig vergelijkingsmateriaal om daaruit de oplossing te halen.'

pages.source: service.archief.nl (NL-HaNA 1.01.02, inv. 6016, 'Liassen Agent Brederode' -- ingekomen brieven en stukken van Pieter van Brederode, agent van de Staten-Generaal in Duitsland en Zwitserland, 1602-1613)
pages.content: folder-cover leaf, handwritten '1602 en 1603' -- confirms the bundle is divided into loose year-folders, image order roughly chronological but NOT a per-letter index

bound register leaf (archival page number '73'/'28' visible), faint bleed-through, an index-tab margin ('Bouillon' visible) -- a different bound sub-document within the same digitised file, not loose correspondence; not dated by this pass

bound negotiation journal/register leaf, archival page number '136', continuous Dutch prose on dealings with 'syne Churf. Excellentie' (an Elector) and 'Marquis Hans Sigismundt', dated internally 'den 3en Octob.' -- no year given on this leaf; no cipher visible
folder-cover leaf, handwritten '1605-1606' -- the year-folder covering our target's date; not yet read past the first 2 leaves

first leaf after the 1605-1606 divider: Brederode reporting his 'reyse nae Heydelbergh' (journey to Heidelberg) and dealings with 'Marquis Joachim Ernest van Brandenburg' -- directly on-topic for our target letter's mission, no cipher visible on this leaf
same leaf as page_index 261, unfolded/re-scanned with a small loose overlay slip removed from view -- no new content
